decisions.reason: The future passive applies legal withholding to part of his wages, with repayment of the debt as purpose. The translation preserves all these details. The legal verb is independently attested and is distinct from decorating food; the invented notice is no claim about a real legal procedure.

US$4,000 fixes the currency. One grand over budget means one thousand dollars above budget, exactly as translated. This is the informal monetary noun; no adjective comparative or superlative is proposed as its form.

A notebook kept for this particular activity is dedicated in the purpose-specific adjective sense. The Chinese preserves the dedicated notebook, words heard, and bus location. It does not misclassify the word as a past-tense action or describe a devoted person.

The adverb measures how much lower the monthly travel costs are. The move closer to work and subsequent comparison make 大幅降低 natural. There is no statistical-significance assertion; the essentially/mostly sense remains a separate use.

Precipitous modifies decline as an adjective describing a sudden adverse change. The shop, sales decline and bridge closure are faithful in Chinese. 急剧的, 骤然的 and 急剧变化的 are adjective descriptions, while the removed 急剧下降/骤然下降 name events. This language approval does not itself prove runtime search ranking.

Mandated takes a review as its object and means officially required. Court, company payment records and compulsory review are preserved. This transitive verb does not rely on the distinct historical territorial-administration verb or the command noun.

The speaker accepts responsibility for sending invitations to the wrong address. The predicative phrase and Chinese account of whose error it was match. The selected sense does not approve the entire unqualified old string about perplexity or malfunction.

The provision of hot meals denotes the act of supplying, used as an uncountable noun. Chinese naturally expresses that action while preserving the council plan and older residents. The sentence does not claim that a plan has already been delivered.

The plural subject is school former attendees or graduates. Multiple generations is naturally 多届 here, and returning for an exhibition is preserved. Both male groups and mixed-gender groups are attested; the definition does not make the plural male-only.

The default is the arrangement applying absent advance agreement to use a separate room. The shared desk, exception and timing are all retained. The noun is a routine fallback option rather than a failure to repay debt.

The tenants negotiate to obtain a longer notice period before signing. Bargain with for marking the desired terms is independently attested. 争取 does not claim that their demand succeeded. This differs from the phrasal expectation sense and does not require a purchase.

The idiom expresses hoped-for financial success when launching the first mobile game. The Chinese preserves hope rather than asserting actual profit. The definition and aliases concern wealth or financial success rather than arbitrary good fortune.
